blurb.en: Each ball is a pygame.sprite.Sprite that carries its own picture, rectangle and position; one Group moves all of them with a single update call and draws all of them with a single draw call.
blurb.zh: 每个球都是一个 pygame.sprite.Sprite：自己带着图、矩形和位置；一个 Group 用一次 update 把它们全挪一步，用一次 draw 把它们全画出来。

en: A Sprite subclass has two attributes pygame relies on by name: image, the Surface that gets drawn, and rect, the rectangle that says where. Group.draw blits each sprite's image at its rect, and Group.update calls each sprite's own update method with whatever arguments you give it - here dt, the seconds since the last frame.
The parent class has to be set up before the sprite is added to a group, so the first line of __init__ hands control to Sprite's own initialiser. Leave it out and adding the ball to a Group fails.

A Rect holds whole numbers only. Rect(1.7, 2.5, 3, 3) keeps (1, 2) and rect.move(1.7, 0) moves by 1 - the fraction is chopped off - while assigning a float to one of its attributes rounds it. A ball meant to go half a pixel a frame (30 pixels per second at 60 frames per second) would, depending on how you add, either never move or move a whole pixel a frame, twice too fast. So the true position lives in pos, a Vector2 of floats, and only the rounded copy goes into rect just before drawing.

positions_after is the logic without a window: it builds a Group of balls, calls update steps times and returns each ball's position as a pair of floats, in the order the balls were added (a Group remembers that order). Two balls starting at (0, 80) and (0, 160) with velocities (60, 0) and (120, 0), updated 60 times with dt = 1/60, end at (60.0, 80.0) and (120.0, 160.0) - one second of travel.

In the window: three coloured squares, 20 pixels wide, slide from the left edge to the right at 60, 120 and 180 pixels per second on the rows y = 80, 160 and 240. When a ball goes past the right edge, main moves it back to just off the left edge, so the three keep crossing the 480-pixel window, the slowest taking about 8 seconds a lap and the fastest under 3.
zh: Sprite 子类有两个属性 pygame 按名字去找：image 是要画的那张 Surface，rect 是说明画在哪里的矩形。Group.draw 把每个精灵的 image 贴到它的 rect 上；Group.update 调用每个精灵自己的 update 方法，你给什么实参就传什么——这里是 dt，上一帧到这一帧过去的秒数。
精灵加进组之前，父类那一层必须先初始化好，所以 __init__ 的第一行把控制权交给 Sprite 自己的初始化方法。漏掉它，把球加进 Group 时就会出错。

Rect 只装整数。Rect(1.7, 2.5, 3, 3) 留下的是 (1, 2)，rect.move(1.7, 0) 只挪 1——小数部分直接砍掉；而给它的属性赋一个浮点数，会被四舍五入。一个本该每帧走半个像素的球（每秒 60 帧下每秒 30 像素），看你怎么加，要么永远一动不动，要么每帧走一整个像素、快了一倍。所以真实位置放在 pos 里——一个装浮点数的 Vector2，只在画之前把取整后的副本交给 rect。

positions_after 是不开窗口的那部分逻辑：建一个装着球的 Group，调用 steps 次 update，然后按球加进来的顺序（Group 记得这个顺序）交回每个球的位置，每个位置是两个浮点数。两个球从 (0, 80) 和 (0, 160) 出发，速度 (60, 0) 和 (120, 0)，dt = 1/60 更新 60 次，停在 (60.0, 80.0) 和 (120.0, 160.0)——走了整整一秒。
窗口里看到的：三个 20 像素宽的彩色方块，在 y = 80、160、240 三行上从左边往右滑，每秒分别 60、120、180 像素。球滑过右边之后，main 把它挪回左边外面一点，于是三个球一圈圈穿过 480 像素宽的窗口，最慢的一圈约 8 秒，最快的不到 3 秒。

lineNotes.en: The real position, kept as floats.
lineNotes.zh: 真实位置，用浮点数存。

lineNotes.en: Each time round is one frame: the Group calls update(dt) on every ball, in the order they were added.
lineNotes.zh: 每转一圈就是一帧：Group 按加进来的顺序，对每个球调用 update(dt)。

lineNotes.en: Past the right edge: send it back to the left so the demo keeps going.
lineNotes.zh: 滑出右边了：送回左边，让演示一直转下去。

blurb.en: Draw a small ship on a Surface, save it as ship.png, load it back, and use a colour key so its magenta background disappears.
blurb.zh: 在 Surface 上画一艘小船，存成 ship.png，再读回来；用透明色让它的品红底色消失。

en: Games normally load their pictures from files, but a program on this page cannot come with a picture file: the copy button copies the .py only. So the program makes its own. make_ship paints a 40 by 30 Surface magenta, draws a light-blue triangle with a white dot on it, and main saves it with pygame.image.save as ship.png.

The file is written into the folder the program runs from - its working directory. In PyCharm that is normally the folder that holds the .py, so ship.png appears next to your program after the first run, and each run overwrites it.

pygame.image.load reads the file back into a new Surface. convert_alpha then changes it into the same pixel format as the window, with an alpha channel, so blitting it every frame is fast; convert does the same without the alpha channel. Both need the window to exist already - call them before set_mode and pygame raises an error.

A PNG saved from an ordinary Surface has no transparency in it, so the magenta background is still a real colour. set_colorkey picks one colour to skip when blitting: every magenta pixel is left out and whatever is underneath shows through.

In the window: two copies of the same picture side by side on a dark background. The left one was loaded and converted only, so you see the ship sitting on a magenta rectangle. The right one also had its colour key set, so only the blue triangle and its white dot show.

get_rect(center=...) makes a rectangle the size of the image and places its centre at the point given - that is how each copy is centred on its third of the window. The ship's sides are even, so its centre is exact; for an odd size pygame rounds half the width and half the height down before subtracting them from the centre - a 5 by 3 rectangle centred on (10, 10) gets its top-left corner at (8, 9).
zh: 游戏一般从文件里读图，可本页的程序没法附带图片文件：复制按钮只复制 .py。所以程序自己造一张。make_ship 把一张 40×30 的 Surface 涂成品红，在上面画一个浅蓝三角形和一个白点，main 用 pygame.image.save 把它存成 ship.png。
文件写在程序运行的那个文件夹里，也就是它的工作目录。在 PyCharm 里一般就是放 .py 的那个文件夹，所以跑过一次之后，ship.png 就出现在你的程序旁边，每跑一次覆盖一次。
pygame.image.load 把文件读回成一张新的 Surface。convert_alpha 再把它换成和窗口相同的像素格式、并带上透明通道，每帧贴图时就快；convert 做同样的事，只是不带透明通道。两者都要求窗口已经存在——在 set_mode 之前调用，pygame 会报错。
从普通 Surface 存出来的 PNG 里没有透明信息，品红底色仍是一种实实在在的颜色。set_colorkey 指定一种颜色在贴图时跳过：每个品红像素都不画，底下是什么就露出什么。
窗口里看到的：深色背景上并排两份同一张图。左边那份只读进来、转换过，所以看到船坐在一块品红矩形上；右边那份还设了透明色，只剩蓝三角形和它上面的白点。
get_rect(center=...) 造一个和图一样大的矩形，并把它的中心放在给定的点上——两份图就是这样各自居中在窗口的三分之一处。船的两条边都是偶数，中心正好；边长是奇数时，pygame 先把半宽、半高往下取整，再从中心减去——5×3 的矩形以 (10, 10) 为中心，左上角落在 (8, 9)。

lineNotes.en: Paint the whole picture magenta first; this is the colour that will later be made see-through.
lineNotes.zh: 先把整张图涂成品红；之后要变透明的就是这个颜色。

lineNotes.en: The same file loaded again, without a colour key, for comparison.
lineNotes.zh: 同一个文件再读一次，不设透明色，用来对照。

blurb.en: Which frame of an animation to show is worked out from the milliseconds that have passed, not from how many frames the loop has drawn - so the animation runs at the same speed on a fast or a slow computer.
blurb.zh: 动画显示第几帧，按过去了多少毫秒来算，而不是按主循环画了多少帧——这样动画在快电脑和慢电脑上一样快。

en: clock.tick(60) returns the milliseconds since the previous call, so adding it up gives the time since the start. frame_index turns that time into a frame number: every frame is shown for frame_ms milliseconds, so the number of whole frame lengths that have passed is the step the animation has reached.

A looping animation starts again after its last frame, so the step wraps round with the remainder. With 6 frames of 120 ms: 0 ms and 119 ms show frame 0, 120 ms shows frame 1, 719 ms frame 5, and at 720 ms it is back to frame 0.

A play-once animation, such as an explosion, stops on its last frame instead: the step is capped at the last index, one less than the number of frames. With the same numbers it reaches frame 5 at 600 ms and is still on frame 5 at 720 ms and 1000 ms.

Counting frames drawn instead (add 1 every time round the loop) would tie the animation to the frame rate: at 30 frames per second it would play at half speed. The same idea for movement is on the Pygame Basics page.

In the window: two yellow circles, each drawn from six frames whose radius grows from 6 to 26 pixels. The left one grows, snaps back to small and grows again, over and over, once every 0.72 seconds. The right one grows once in the first 0.6 seconds and then stays at full size. Pressing any key sets the time back to 0, so both start again from the smallest frame.
zh: clock.tick(60) 交回上一次调用以来的毫秒数，累加起来就是从开始到现在的时间。frame_index 把这个时间换成帧号：每一帧显示 frame_ms 毫秒，所以过去了几个完整的帧时长，动画就走到了第几步。
循环播放的动画放完最后一帧又从头来，所以步数用取余绕回去。6 帧、每帧 120 毫秒：0 毫秒和 119 毫秒显示第 0 帧，120 毫秒显示第 1 帧，719 毫秒第 5 帧，到 720 毫秒又回到第 0 帧。
只播一次的动画（比如爆炸）改为停在最后一帧：步数封顶在最后一个下标，比帧数少 1。同样的数字下，600 毫秒到达第 5 帧，720 毫秒、1000 毫秒都还停在第 5 帧。
要是改成数画了多少帧（主循环每转一圈加 1），动画就被绑在帧率上：每秒 30 帧时它只有一半速度。运动里的同一个道理见「pygame 入门」一页。
窗口里看到的：两个黄色的圆，各由六帧组成，半径从 6 像素长到 26 像素。左边那个长大、一下缩回最小、再长大，一遍遍重复，每 0.72 秒一轮；右边那个在头 0.6 秒里长大一次，之后一直保持最大。按任意键把时间拨回 0，两个都从最小那帧重新开始。

lineNotes.en: tick returns milliseconds since the last call; the running total is the time since the start.
lineNotes.zh: tick 交回距上次调用的毫秒数；累加起来就是从开始到现在的时间。

lineNotes.en: Any key restarts both animations.
lineNotes.zh: 按任意键，两个动画都从头开始。

blurb.en: A sprite sheet keeps every frame of an animation in one picture, laid out in rows; frame_rects works out the rectangle of each frame, row by row, and subsurface cuts them out.
blurb.zh: 精灵表把一段动画的每一帧放在同一张图里、排成几行；frame_rects 按行算出每一帧的矩形，subsurface 把它们切出来。

en: Artists often deliver an animation as one sheet: frames of equal size side by side, row after row. The program cannot ship a picture file, so make_sheet draws its own 160 by 80 sheet in memory: two rows of four 40-pixel cells, each holding a circle of a different colour, the radius growing by 2 pixels from one cell to the next.

frame_rects returns the rectangles as (x, y, width, height) tuples in reading order - the whole first row left to right, then the next row. The outer loop is the row, the inner loop the column, so the column changes fastest. For the 160 by 80 sheet with 40 by 40 frames that gives 8 rectangles, starting (0, 0, 40, 40), (40, 0, 40, 40) and ending (120, 40, 40, 40).

Only whole frames count: sheet_w // frame_w is how many frames fit across, and any strip left over at the right or bottom edge is ignored. A 100 by 50 sheet with 40 by 40 frames gives just two, (0, 0, 40, 40) and (40, 0, 40, 40).

subsurface makes a small Surface that looks into the big one - it shares the sheet's pixels rather than copying them, so cutting frames costs almost nothing. The frames are then played in order, one every 150 milliseconds, the same idea as Animation Frames by the Clock.

In the window: on the left the whole sheet, two rows of four coloured circles on black; on the right one frame at a time, its circle changing colour and growing as the animation walks along the first row and then the second, a full round every 1.2 seconds.
zh: 美术常把一段动画交成一张表：大小相同的帧并排、一行接一行。程序没法附带图片文件，于是 make_sheet 在内存里画一张 160×80 的表：两行、每行四个 40 像素的格子，每格一个颜色不同的圆，半径一格比一格大 2 像素。
frame_rects 按阅读顺序交回矩形，每个是 (x, y, 宽, 高) 元组——先是第一行从左到右，再是下一行。外层循环是行、内层是列，所以列变得最快。160×80 的表、40×40 的帧，得到 8 个矩形，开头是 (0, 0, 40, 40)、(40, 0, 40, 40)，最后是 (120, 40, 40, 40)。
只算完整的帧：sheet_w // frame_w 是一行放得下几帧，右边或下边剩下的窄条不管。100×50 的表、40×40 的帧只得到两个：(0, 0, 40, 40) 和 (40, 0, 40, 40)。
subsurface 造一张小 Surface，它是透过大图的一扇窗——和大图共用像素，不复制，所以切帧几乎不花什么。之后按顺序播放这些帧，每 150 毫秒换一帧，和「按时间换动画帧」是同一个做法。
窗口里看到的：左边是整张表，黑底上两行、每行四个彩色的圆；右边一次只显示一帧，随着动画先走过第一行、再走过第二行，那个圆一边变色一边变大，每 1.2 秒转一轮。

lineNotes.en: Outer loop over rows, so the frames come out row by row.
lineNotes.zh: 外层循环按行，于是帧一行一行地出来。

lineNotes.en: Loop through the frames, 150 ms each.
lineNotes.zh: 循环播放这些帧，每帧 150 毫秒。

blurb.en: Rect.colliderect says whether two rectangles overlap. Rectangles that only touch along an edge do not count.
blurb.zh: Rect.colliderect 判断两个矩形有没有重叠。只是边挨着边的不算。

en: overlaps takes two rectangles as (x, y, width, height) - tuples or Rects both work, because pygame.Rect accepts either - and returns True or False. Almost every 2D game checks collisions this way: each thing on screen has a rectangle around it, and two things hit when their rectangles overlap.

Touching is not overlapping. A rectangle covers the pixels from its left edge up to, but not including, its right edge: Rect(0, 0, 4, 4) covers columns 0 to 3. So Rect(0, 0, 4, 4) and Rect(4, 0, 4, 4) sit side by side sharing no pixel, and colliderect says False; move the second one to x = 3 and they share a column, and it says True.
A rectangle with zero width or zero height covers no pixels at all, and colliderect says False for it against anything - even when it sits right in the middle of the other rectangle.
The box's true position is the float Vector2 pos, rounded into the rectangle just before the test. Arrow keys move it at 200 pixels per second; how the keys are read is on the Pygame Basics page.

In the window: a grey wall on the right and a green 40-pixel box you steer with the arrow keys. The box turns red while it overlaps the wall. Coming in from the left, when its x is 220 its right edge is at 260, exactly the wall's left edge - still green; one pixel further, at 221, it turns red.
The same test written with four comparisons of your own is Rectangle Overlap by Hand; put the two side by side to see that only overlaps changes.
zh: overlaps 接收两个矩形，格式是 (x, y, 宽, 高)——元组或 Rect 都行，因为 pygame.Rect 两种都接受——交回 True 或 False。几乎所有 2D 游戏都这样判碰撞：屏幕上每样东西外面套一个矩形，两个矩形重叠了，两样东西就撞上了。
挨着不等于重叠。一个矩形覆盖从左边开始、到右边为止但不含右边的像素：Rect(0, 0, 4, 4) 覆盖第 0 到第 3 列。所以 Rect(0, 0, 4, 4) 和 Rect(4, 0, 4, 4) 肩并肩、没有共同的像素，colliderect 说 False；把第二个挪到 x = 3，两者共有一列，它就说 True。
宽或高为 0 的矩形一个像素也不覆盖，colliderect 对它和谁比都说 False——哪怕它就在另一个矩形的正中间。
方块的真实位置是浮点的 Vector2 pos，每次判碰撞之前取整放进矩形。方向键让它每秒走 200 像素；按键怎么读见「pygame 入门」一页。
窗口里看到的：右边一堵灰墙，还有一个用方向键操纵的 40 像素绿方块。方块和墙重叠时变红。从左边靠过去，x 为 220 时它的右边在 260，正好是墙的左边——仍是绿的；再往前一像素，到 221 就变红。
用自己写的四个比较做同一件事，见「矩形碰撞：手写四个比较」；两个并排对照，只有 overlaps 不一样。

lineNotes.en: A Rect is a plain value, so it may be made at the top level; the window may not.
lineNotes.zh: Rect 只是个值，可以在顶层造；窗口不行。

lineNotes.en: player is a Rect; overlaps accepts it just like a tuple.
lineNotes.zh: player 是 Rect；overlaps 接收它和接收元组一样。

title.zh: 矩形碰撞：手写四个比较

blurb.en: Two rectangles overlap when they overlap across and overlap down; each of those is two strict comparisons, so four in all - the classic axis-aligned bounding box (AABB) test.
blurb.zh: 两个矩形重叠，当且仅当横向重叠、纵向也重叠；每个方向是两个严格比较，一共四个——经典的轴对齐包围盒（AABB）判断。

en: Look at one direction at a time. Across, rectangle a runs from ax to ax + aw and b from bx to bx + bw. They share some columns exactly when each one starts before the other one ends: a starts left of b's right edge, and b starts left of a's right edge. Down is the same with y and h. The rectangles overlap only when both directions do.

Why strictly less-than and not less-than-or-equal: a rectangle's right edge value is the first column it does not cover - Rect(0, 0, 4, 4) covers columns 0 to 3. If ax equals bx + bw, a starts on the very column where b has already stopped, so they share nothing. With less-than-or-equal the test would call two rectangles that merely touch a hit, and so would disagree with colliderect.
Unpacking a = (ax, ay, aw, ah) in one line works for a tuple and for a pygame.Rect alike, because a Rect can be unpacked into its four numbers.

One difference from colliderect: for a zero-width rectangle lying inside the other one, these four comparisons say True while colliderect says False. Sprites in a game always have a size, so it does not matter here.

In the window: exactly as in Rectangle Overlap with colliderect - a grey wall, a green box on the arrow keys, red while they overlap and still green at x = 220, where the box's right edge only touches the wall. Only overlaps is different.
zh: 一次只看一个方向。横向上，a 从 ax 到 ax + aw，b 从 bx 到 bx + bw。它们有共同的列，恰好是在各自都在对方结束之前开始的时候：a 的起点在 b 的右边之左，b 的起点也在 a 的右边之左。纵向同理，换成 y 和 h。两个方向都重叠，矩形才重叠。
为什么是严格小于而不是小于等于：矩形右边的值是它不覆盖的第一列——Rect(0, 0, 4, 4) 覆盖第 0 到第 3 列。如果 ax 等于 bx + bw，a 恰好从 b 已经结束的那一列开始，两者没有共同的列。用小于等于的话，只是挨着的两个矩形也会被判成撞上，就与 colliderect 不一致了。
一行把 a 拆成 (ax, ay, aw, ah)，对元组和 pygame.Rect 都行，因为 Rect 可以拆成它的四个数。
与 colliderect 有一处不同：宽为 0 的矩形落在另一个矩形里面时，这四个比较说 True，colliderect 说 False。游戏里的精灵总有大小，这里不碍事。
窗口里看到的：和「矩形碰撞：colliderect」一模一样——一堵灰墙、一个方向键操纵的绿方块，重叠时变红；x = 220 时方块的右边只是挨着墙，仍是绿的。只有 overlaps 不一样。

lineNotes.en: Works for a tuple and for a Rect: both unpack into four numbers.
lineNotes.zh: 元组和 Rect 都行：两者都能拆成四个数。

lineNotes.at: down = ay < by + bh and by < ay + ah
lineNotes.en: Overlap down: each one starts above where the other one ends.
lineNotes.zh: 纵向重叠：各自都在对方结束之前开始。

blurb.en: Two circles touch when the distance between their centres is no more than the sum of their radii. Comparing the squares of both sides gives the same answer with no square root.
blurb.zh: 两圆圆心的距离不超过半径之和，两圆就碰上了。两边都平方再比，答案相同，还不用开方。

en: For round things, rectangles are a poor fit: two balls whose boxes overlap at the corners may be well apart. The exact test is by distance. If the centres are dx apart across and dy apart down, Pythagoras gives the distance as the square root of dx squared plus dy squared, and the circles touch when that is at most r1 + r2.

Both sides are never negative, so squaring them keeps the comparison the same way round - and the square root, the slow part, is no longer needed. Exactly touching counts: centres 5 apart (3 across, 4 down) with radii 2 and 3 touch at one point, and the test says True.

pygame.sprite.collide_circle does the same test on two sprites: it reads each sprite's radius attribute (if a sprite has none, it makes up a circle big enough to enclose its rect), takes the centres from their rects, and compares squared distance with the squared sum of the radii - its own source shows it. main runs both so you can see they agree.
The balls here are plain pygame.sprite.Sprite objects with image, rect and radius set from outside, rather than a subclass: for a sprite with no behaviour of its own, that is enough.

In the window: a grey circle of radius 50 in the middle and a green circle of radius 30 that follows the mouse. The title bar shows both answers, circles_touch and collide_circle, which always match, and the background turns dark red while they are True. With the mouse straight above the grey circle's centre at y = 80 the centres are exactly 80 apart and the circles just touch - True; at y = 79 they are 81 apart - False.
zh: 圆的东西套矩形不合适：两个球的外接矩形在角上重叠时，球本身可能还隔得老远。准确的判断看距离。圆心横向相距 dx、纵向相距 dy，勾股定理给出距离是 dx 平方加 dy 平方再开方；这个距离不超过 r1 + r2，两圆就碰上了。
两边都不会是负数，所以同时平方不改变比较的方向——而开方这步最慢的计算就省掉了。恰好相切也算碰：圆心相距 5（横 3、纵 4）、半径 2 和 3 的两个圆在一点上相切，判断给出 True。
pygame.sprite.collide_circle 对两个精灵做的是同一个判断：读每个精灵的 radius 属性（没有的话，它自己造一个刚好包住 rect 的圆），圆心取自 rect，拿距离的平方和半径和的平方比——看它的源码就知道。main 两个都跑，让你看到它们一致。
这里的球是普通的 pygame.sprite.Sprite 对象，image、rect、radius 都从外面设，不写子类：一个没有自己行为的精灵，这样就够了。
窗口里看到的：中间一个半径 50 的灰圆，一个半径 30、跟着鼠标走的绿圆。标题栏同时显示 circles_touch 和 collide_circle 两个答案，它们总是一致；两者为 True 时背景变成暗红。鼠标放在灰圆圆心正上方 y = 80 处，两圆心恰好相距 80，两圆刚好相切——True；到 y = 79，相距 81——False。

lineNotes.en: The largest centre-to-centre distance at which they still touch.
lineNotes.zh: 两圆还能碰上时，圆心之间允许的最大距离。

lineNotes.en: The green circle follows the mouse: its centre goes where the pointer is.
lineNotes.zh: 绿圆跟着鼠标：它的圆心放到指针所在的位置。

blurb.en: groupcollide checks every bullet in one group against every target in another, removes both on a hit and reports who hit what. It settles one bullet at a time, in order.
blurb.zh: groupcollide 拿一个组里的每颗子弹去比另一个组里的每个目标，命中就把两边都删掉，并报告谁打中了谁。它按顺序一颗一颗地结算。

en: pygame.sprite.spritecollide(sprite, group, dokill) returns the list of sprites in group whose rects overlap one sprite; with dokill True it also removes them. groupcollide(shots, enemies, dokilla, dokillb) does that for every sprite of the first group, and returns a dictionary: each bullet that hit something is a key, and its value is the list of targets it hit. The two dokill flags say whether the bullets and the targets are removed on a hit. kill() removes a sprite from every group it is in, so it is no longer updated or drawn.
The score here is the number of targets destroyed, so settle adds up the lengths of the lists in the dictionary. One wide bullet that covers two targets scores 2.

The bullets are settled one at a time, in the order they were added to the group. If two bullets both overlap the same target, the first one destroys it; by the time the second is checked the target is gone, so the second has hit nothing and stays in its group, flying on. For bullets (10, 10, 4, 10) and (12, 12, 4, 10) and one target (0, 0, 30, 30), resolve returns a score of 1, the second bullet still there, and no targets left. Thinking of all the hits as happening at once would wrongly remove both bullets.

resolve is the collision step without a window: it builds the two groups from (x, y, width, height) tuples, settles them, and returns the score with the rectangles of the bullets and targets that are left, as tuples, in their original order.

Box stores its height as a float in y, for the same reason as in Sprite Subclass and Group: a Rect would chop the fraction off every frame. A bullet that has flown off the top of the screen removes itself, so the group does not fill up with bullets nobody can see.

In the window: seven red targets in a row near the top, a white gun at the bottom that follows the mouse left and right, and the score at the bottom left. Each press of Space fires a thin white bullet upwards at 300 pixels per second; when it reaches a target, the bullet and the target both vanish and the score goes up by one.
zh: pygame.sprite.spritecollide(sprite, group, dokill) 交回 group 里所有 rect 与这一个精灵重叠的精灵组成的列表；dokill 为 True 时还把它们删掉。groupcollide(shots, enemies, dokilla, dokillb) 对第一个组的每个精灵都这样做一遍，交回一个字典：每颗打中了东西的子弹是一个键，值是它打中的目标列表。两个 dokill 说的是命中时删不删子弹、删不删目标。kill() 把精灵从它所在的每个组里删掉，于是它不再被更新、也不再被画出来。
这里的分数是被消灭的目标个数，所以 settle 把字典里各个列表的长度加起来。一颗宽子弹同时盖住两个目标，得 2 分。
子弹按加进组的顺序一颗一颗结算。两颗子弹都和同一个目标重叠时，第一颗把它消灭；轮到第二颗时目标已经不在了，第二颗什么也没打中，留在组里继续飞。子弹 (10, 10, 4, 10)、(12, 12, 4, 10) 和一个目标 (0, 0, 30, 30)，resolve 交回分数 1、第二颗子弹还在、目标一个不剩。当成所有命中同时发生，就会错误地把两颗子弹都删掉。
resolve 是不开窗口的碰撞这一步：用 (x, y, 宽, 高) 元组建两个组、结算，交回分数，以及剩下的子弹和目标的矩形——都是元组，保持原来的顺序。
Box 把纵坐标用浮点存在 y 里，理由和「Sprite 子类与 Group」一样：Rect 每帧都会砍掉小数部分。飞出屏幕顶的子弹把自己删掉，组里就不会堆满谁也看不见的子弹。
窗口里看到的：靠上一排七个红色目标，底下一门白色的炮跟着鼠标左右移动，左下角是分数。每按一下空格，就向上射出一颗细长的白子弹，每秒 300 像素；碰到目标时，子弹和目标一起消失，分数加一。

lineNotes.en: The true height, kept as a float; the Rect only gets the rounded copy.
lineNotes.zh: 真实的纵坐标，用浮点存；Rect 只拿取整后的副本。

lineNotes.en: After this, shots and enemies hold only what survived.
lineNotes.zh: 这一步之后，shots 和 enemies 里只剩下没被删掉的。

lineNotes.en: The same collision step as resolve, once per frame.
lineNotes.zh: 和 resolve 里同一个碰撞步骤，每帧一次。

blurb.en: A mask records which pixels of an image are solid. Two masks overlap only where solid pixels really meet - so two discs whose boxes overlap at the corners do not collide.
blurb.zh: mask 记下一张图里哪些像素是实的。两张 mask 只有实像素真的碰在一起才算重叠——所以外接矩形在角上重叠的两个圆盘并不相撞。

en: pygame.mask.from_surface looks at a Surface with an alpha channel and makes a grid of on and off bits: on where the pixel is solid, off where it is transparent. make_disc draws a filled circle of radius 40 on an 80 by 80 transparent Surface, so its mask is a disc of on bits with off corners.

mask_a.overlap(mask_b, offset) slides mask_b to offset, measured from mask_a's top-left corner, and looks for a place where both have an on bit. It returns the first such point as (x, y), or None when there is none. The offset is simply b's rectangle position minus a's.

Checking every pixel costs far more than comparing four numbers, so a game usually tests the boxes first and only asks the masks when the boxes overlap. main computes both so you can see where they differ.

At the start the grey disc's centre is at (200, 160) and the green one's at (260, 220). Their boxes overlap - the centres are only 60 apart each way, less than the 80 a box is wide - but the distance between the centres is about 84.9, more than the two radii added together, 80. So the boxes collide and the pixels do not.

In the window: two discs, each inside a thin grey outline showing its box. The green disc follows the mouse. The title bar shows both answers, boxes overlap and pixels overlap; the background turns dark red only when pixels overlap is True. Bring the discs together corner to corner and you will see the boxes overlap well before the discs actually meet.
zh: pygame.mask.from_surface 看一张带透明通道的 Surface，造出一格格的开关位：实的像素是开，透明的是关。make_disc 在一张 80×80 的透明 Surface 上画一个半径 40 的实心圆，所以它的 mask 是一块圆形的开位，四个角是关的。
mask_a.overlap(mask_b, offset) 把 mask_b 挪到 offset 处（从 mask_a 的左上角量起），找两者都是开位的地方。找到就把第一个这样的点作为 (x, y) 交回，找不到交回 None。offset 就是 b 的矩形位置减去 a 的。
逐像素检查比比四个数贵得多，所以游戏通常先比矩形，只在矩形重叠时才去问 mask。main 两个都算，让你看到它们在哪里不同。
开始时灰圆盘的圆心在 (200, 160)、绿圆盘的在 (260, 220)。两个矩形是重叠的——圆心横、纵都只差 60，小于矩形的宽 80——但圆心之间的距离约 84.9，比两个半径加起来的 80 大。所以矩形相撞，像素没有。
窗口里看到的：两个圆盘，各自外面有一圈细灰框表示它的矩形。绿圆盘跟着鼠标走。标题栏同时显示 boxes overlap 和 pixels overlap 两个答案；只有 pixels overlap 为 True 时背景才变暗红。让两个圆盘角对角靠近，你会看到矩形早就重叠了，圆盘才真正碰上。

lineNotes.en: The mask is made once, not every frame: the picture never changes.
lineNotes.zh: mask 只造一次，不是每帧都造：图不会变。

lineNotes.en: The precise, slower test.
lineNotes.zh: 精确但较慢的判断。
